Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the left lane of a multi-lane roadway in Katy, Texas, when Driver 1 moved toward the right
lane and made contact with the side of a vehicle operated by Driver 2. The contact was a sideswipe, and both
vehicles came to rest on the shoulder. Responding officers spoke with Driver 1, Driver 2, and two independent
witnesses, all of whom described the collision in the same sequence. Photographs taken at the scene show damage
along the right side of Driver 1's vehicle and the left side of Driver 2's vehicle, consistent with the reported impact.
Driver 1 is listed on the auto policy for the vehicle involved. A Passenger was seated in Driver 1's vehicle at the time,
and both the witnesses and the officers confirmed the Passenger's presence. No prior damage to either vehicle was
noted in the records reviewed. Driver 1 reported a wrist fracture and was transported for evaluation. At this time it is
not clear whether the reported injury resulted from this collision, and the medical findings will need to be reviewed
before a determination is made.
